transfer_model: P50 CPU->GPU0 all Phase 0 payloads; linear interpolation between knots; >8GiB equals repeated 8GiB chunks plus interpolated remainder
extraction_rule: per round: release=max(emitted_at), deadline=max(result_at); all tool calls in the round require timestamps; pause must be positive. write_stdin continuations remain their own round calls and are not latency-summed.

session_replay.selection_rationale: complete moderately sized sessions only; no truncation or policy-dependent filtering

poisson_replay.tuple_sampling: sample complete TraceLab event tuple jointly
